simple.summary: שֵׁשַׁךְ (Shêshak) means Sheshak , a symbolic name of Babylon First listed occurrence: Jer 25 26.

definitions.short: Sheshak , a symbolic name of Babylon
definitions.full: H8347. Sheshak שֵׁשַׁךְ proper name, of a territory = בָּבֶל (Jerome Rabb and modern; by Atbaš ( ׳בש׳את ), i.e. disguising name by substituting last letter of alphabet for first, next last for second, etc., compare Thes); — Jer 51:41 and hence (perhaps gloss) 25:26 (see Gie).
